search_document:
User Request: Top 5 products by sale, sorted in alphabetical order

Dashboard Components:
Title: Top 5 Products by Sales
Type: table
Description: List of top 5 products sorted in alphabetical order based on sales
Title: Total Sales Revenue
Type: kpi
Description: Total revenue generated from all products
Title: Sales Trend
Type: chart
Description: Sales trend over time for all products

sql_queries.title: Top 5 Products by Sales
sql_queries.description: List of top 5 products sorted in alphabetical order based on sales
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, p.ProductName ASC LIMIT 5

sql_queries.title: Total Sales Revenue
sql_queries.description: Total revenue generated from all products
sql_queries.sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM "Order Details" od

sql_queries.title: Sales Trend
sql_queries.description: Sales trend over time for all products
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice * (1 - od.Discount)) AS MonthlySales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) ORDER BY Month
